_comment: Copy to tools/smoke.json (git ignores it) and fill in your boards. Fields starting with _ are comments. The header of tools/smoke.py says what each check does.

boards._comment: A U30 Air, updated from a mirror on the computer (MU300_RELEASE_URL=<mirror_url>/<tag>)
boards.name: u30-mirror

boards._comment: An F50, from a release directory on the device (mu300-update apply --from); --release-dir uploads it first. expect_kernel is 7.2 unless it names a 7.2 release.
boards.name: f50-from
